title: Understanding Polynomial Features
text: Adding polynomial features increases the complexity of the model. Think about how this might affect the model's ability to fit the training data versus new data.

title: Bias and Variance Trade-off
text: Consider how increasing model complexity affects bias and variance. A more complex model might fit the training data better, but how does it perform on unseen data?
